title: Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. to Report Second Quarter Fiscal Year 2027 Results on Monday, November 9, 2026 | Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc.
summary: The Investor Relations website contains information about Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc.'s business for stockholders, potential investors, and financial analysts.
body_markdown:
NEW YORK--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Oct. 13, 2026-- Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. (NASDAQ: TTWO) today announced that it plans to report financial results for its second quarter of fiscal year 2027, ended September 30, 2026, after the market close on Monday, November 9, 2026. The Company plans to hold a conference call to discuss its results at 4:30 p.m. Eastern Time, which can be accessed by dialing (833) 461-5787 (Meeting ID: 112-490-011). A live, listen-only webcast and a replay of the call will be available at[http://www.take2games.com/ir](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.take2games.com%2Fir&esheet=54616684&newsitemid=20261013510921&lan=en-US&anchor=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.take2games.com%2Fir&index=1&md5=e8f2a80a3cee10ec19e5c744133422bb) .


**About Take-Two Interactive Software**


Headquartered in New York City, Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. is a leading developer, publisher, and marketer of interactive entertainment for consumers around the globe. We develop and publish products principally through Rockstar Games, 2K, and Zynga. Our strategy is to create hit entertainment experiences, delivered on every platform relevant to our audience through a variety of sound business models. Our pillars - creativity, innovation, and efficiency - guide us as we strive to create the highest quality, most captivating experiences for our consumers. The Company’s common stock is publicly traded on NASDAQ under the symbol TTWO. For more corporate and product information please visit our website at[http://www.take2games.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.take2games.com&esheet=54616684&newsitemid=20261013510921&lan=en-US&anchor=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.take2games.com&index=2&md5=5feda2217a2efbf5574b78de4d2fa957) .
